key_capabilities.note: Library size is stated differently on different pages: home says 'over 150 simulations in up to 97 environments'; the nurses page says 'Our marketplace of 300+ high-fidelity simulated patient encounters' and, lower down, 'We offer over 220 Simulated Patient Encounters'; platform says 'hundreds of pre-built patient encounters' and '474 +' 'Unique Settings'. The Virtual Manikin page says only 'Two Virtual Manikin™ scenarios are currently available in the U.S. and Europe' with more 'in development', while the nurses page says Virtual Manikin can 'create thousands of simulated patient encounters'. The AI Assistant page says it 'is not open-ended generative AI' and that dialogue is expert-authored; the Scenario Editor page separately lists 'AI-generated audio' for new responses. Other features stated but not listed: 'Upload custom EMR slides', 'Add medications to Pyxis', and custom scenario builds by the SimX in-house team.
